sections.heading: DAY ONE...TODAY AND TONIGHT
sections.text: Thunderstorms are expected this afternoon and evening. Some storms will be severe with damaging winds, large hail and a tornado or two possible.

sections.heading: DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...THURSDAY THROUGH TUESDAY
SPOTTER INFORMATION STATEMENT
sections.text: Spotter activation will be needed this afternoon and evening. Please report severe weather to the National Weather Service.
